paymentSettings.upiVpaOverrideHint: Without this, the app guesses a UPI ID from your account number and IFSC (e.g. 123456789012@sbi) — this is rarely a real, working payee, so student payments will fail with an error inside their UPI app. Enter the same UPI ID you'd give someone to pay you directly (the one behind your bank's UPI QR code, e.g. name@oksbi, name@ybl, name@paytm) to fix this.
